name: Walmart General Merchandise DC 6016, New Braunfels TX

fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled NW entrance off I-35 frontage road: curved truck driveway pinches to a checkpoint with guard booth and regulatory placard signs (confirmed in Street View pano RGOuNXZiISH58cGvHIZ03w, 2018-12).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small canopied guard booth beside the entry lane, visible in Street View heading 110/250 - ~1-2 space footprint with windows, set against the building NW corner.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - a staffed guard booth is present, so this is a manned gate not a remote/kiosk check-in.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Wide paved apron between the I-35 frontage road and the building face provides ample room for trucks to stage before the checkpoint (seen in Street View).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved yard inside the gate ahead of the dock doors and drop rows.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long curved approach from the frontage road can hold a queue of 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide entry apron with multiple lane widths and unused paved width - physical room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ - dock doors with trailers backed in run the full length of the long SW wall plus the NW short wall; a 1.4M+ sqft GM DC.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ - extensive trailer drop yards: dozens of long parallel trailer rows fill the SW field and additional rows on the E/SE side.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Active dock banks on two distinct building faces (long SW wall and short NW wall) suggest separated ship/receive flows; medium confidence from overhead only.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound from apron width; exact lane count not crisply resolved in 2018 Street View.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Estimated 2 outbound; same lane group as entry (entryExitTogether).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: main Walmart GM DC plus two additional large warehouse buildings to the south/southeast with their own dock faces and trailer parking.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; access is road/truck only off I-35.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town / open country alongside I-35 north of New Braunfels - surrounded by undeveloped land; classed Rural.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 92.1 acres from shoelace on the traced perimeter ring (main DC + drop yards + southern annex buildings).
